input.content: You work for the user from a Linux sandbox: bash, Python 3.12 with pandas and openpyxl, and curl, in /workspace. The company's apps (Google Drive, Gmail and others) are your MCP tools. Move file content between the workspace and Google Drive with the file API described in /workspace/OFFICEENV.md (its URL and token are in the environment variables OFFICEENV_API_URL and OFFICEENV_API_TOKEN), not by pasting it into tool calls, and do data work with code. When the task is done, call the user_complete_task tool with a one-line summary.

You are Alex Morgan in finance operations. Reconcile September's customer payments. In the Google Drive folder 'Month-end close' you will find bank_statement_2026-09.csv (the bank export) and ar_open_invoices.csv (the open invoices).

Rules: a bank line is a credit when its amount is positive; ignore every other line. A credit pays an open invoice when its reference contains that invoice's id (INV- followed by five digits, in any letter case). Add up all the credits that pay each invoice: the invoice is paid when they equal its amount exactly, partial when they are more than zero but less, and unpaid when no credit pays it. A credit whose reference contains no open invoice's id is unmatched.

In the same folder, save reconciliation_2026-09.csv with the columns invoice_id, status and paid_amount_usd, one row per open invoice, and unmatched_payments_2026-09.csv with the columns date, amount_usd and reference, one row per unmatched credit. Then post the summary to the #finance-close Slack channel in exactly this form: 'September reconciliation: paid <n>, partial <n>, unpaid <n>, unmatched <n>'. Do not edit the source files.

deliveries.body:
Hi Alex,

Could you pull Q3 paid spend per vendor from the AP ledger export (ap_ledger_2026.csv in the Finance folder)? Q3 means 1 July to 30 September 2026 inclusive. Count only lines with status paid. The export imported some invoices twice: count each invoice_id once. Sum amount_usd per vendor and round to cents.

Please save the result as q3_vendor_spend.csv in the Finance folder, with exactly two columns, vendor and total_usd, one row per vendor that had paid spend, and reply to me with the three vendors with the highest totals.

Thanks,
Mia

deliveries.subject: Q3 vendor spend workbook
deliveries.body:
Hi Alex,

Could you pull Q3 paid spend per vendor from the AP ledger workbook (ap_ledger_2026.xlsx in the Finance folder; the invoice lines are on its Ledger sheet)? Q3 means 1 July to 30 September 2026 inclusive. Count only lines with status paid. The export imported some invoices twice: count each invoice_id once. Sum amount_usd per vendor and round to cents.

Please save the result as an Excel workbook, q3_vendor_spend.xlsx, in the Finance folder, with one sheet named Summary: a header row with exactly two columns, vendor and total_usd, then one row per vendor that had paid spend. Then reply to me with the three vendors with the highest totals.

Thanks,
Mia
